scenario: a buy-now-pay-later service tracking installment payment compliance
title: Classify installment payment risk tiers
prompt: You are working with a buy-now-pay-later service tracking installment payment compliance, modeled on consumer credit reporting datasets (data.gov). The installment_schedules table has one row per account. Write a query that returns account_id, customer_name, risk_tier, and adjusted_late_fee, ordered by account_id ascending. risk_tier and adjusted_late_fee are computed columns -- build each one exactly as described in Field expectations below.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE installment_schedules ( account_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_name VARCHAR(100), days_overdue VARCHAR(20), grace_days_allowed INT, late_fee NUMERIC(10,2) );
answer_key:
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    customer_name,
    late_fee,
    COALESCE(grace_days_allowed, 7) AS effective_grace,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(days_overdue, ''))) = 'never_late' THEN 0
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(days_overdue), '')::INT, 0)
    END AS effective_overdue
  FROM installment_schedules
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  customer_name,
  CASE
    WHEN effective_overdue = 0 THEN 'low'
    WHEN effective_overdue BETWEEN 1 AND 14 THEN 'medium'
    WHEN effective_overdue > effective_grace THEN 'critical'
    ELSE 'high'
  END AS risk_tier,
  ROUND(late_fee / NULLIF(1 + effective_grace, 1), 2) AS adjusted_late_fee
FROM parsed
ORDER BY account_id;
user_solution:
/* notes */
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        customer_name,
        (CASE WHEN (days_overdue = 'never_late' OR days_overdue IS NULL OR days_overdue = '') THEN 0 ELSE days_overdue::int END)::INT AS days_overdue,
        CASE WHEN grace_days_allowed IS NULL THEN 7 ELSE grace_days_allowed::int END AS grace_days_allowed,
        late_fee
    FROM installment_schedules
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    customer_name,
    CASE WHEN days_overdue = 0 THEN 'low'
        WHEN days_overdue >= 1 AND days_overdue <= 14 THEN 'medium'
        WHEN days_overdue >= 15 AND days_overdue <= grace_days_allowed THEN 'high'
        WHEN days_overdue > grace_days_allowed THEN 'critical'
    END AS risk_tier,
    ROUND(CASE 
        WHEN grace_days_allowed = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE late_fee / NULLIF(1 + grace_days_allowed, 0) 
    END, 2) AS adjusted_late_fee
FROM base
ORDER BY 1;
